newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Jan oil output down 3.6 percent yr-on-yr.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Jan oil output down 3.6 percent yr-on-yr.

text.p: Singapore's January petroleum manufacturing output fell by 3.6 percent compared with the same month a year before, the Economic Development Board (EDB) said on Wednesday.

"The petroleum industry declined by 3.6 percent as refiners processed less due to lower margins," EDB said in a statement. "Demand for fuel oil had also lessened after the winter season." In January refiners in Singapore, including Shell Singapore and Esso Singapore, had cut crude runs by seven and between 15-20 percent, respectively, after incurring losses.
The poor margins were due to soaring crude prices at that time and a slump in key petroleum products such as diesel, jet fuel and fuel oil.
